title: Correct charge sign
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state that the ball carries a positive charge.

title: Correct charge magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct numerical value for the charge, approximately 2.89 × 10⁻⁶ C or an equivalent exact form.

title: Correct tension value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct numerical value for the string tension, 0.1 N.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution should correctly identify the three forces (gravity, tension, electric) and set up the horizontal and vertical equilibrium conditions.

title: Correct force resolution
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly resolve the tension force into components or apply trigonometry (tan θ = F_e / F_g, cos θ = F_g / T) to relate the forces.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The final answers should be presented with correct SI units (Coulombs and Newtons).

title: Sign error in charge
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the student incorrectly states the charge is negative, given the described field direction and equilibrium position.

title: Trigonometric error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points for using sine/cosine/tangent incorrectly in the force balance equations (e.g., mixing up opposite/adjacent sides).
